AL SEER MARINE: DISPOSED A PORTION OF ITS LISTED EQUITY INVESTMENTS THROUGH SEPARATE ON-MARKET TRANSACTIONS EXECUTED AT PREVAILING MARKET PRICES
AL SEER MARINE: PROCEEDS GENERATED FROM THESE DISPOSALS WERE APPLIED TOWARD VOLUNTARY PREPAYMENT OF AN AED 600 MILLION LOAN TRANCHE
AL SEER MARINE: CONFIRMS THAT THE VOLUNTARY PREPAYMENT WAS COMPLETED IN FULL DURING SEPTEMBER 2026
AL SEER MARINE: VOLUNTARY PREPAYMENT HAS REDUCED CO'S OUTSTANDING BORROWINGS AND ASSOCIATED FINANCE COSTS
